description: Provision a US local number for an inbox. Requires auth. Free includes no numbers (HTTP 402). Starter caps at 3. Pro includes 3 and caps at 25. Each billable number is $3/month with 100 segments. With COOPER_SMS_BILLING=stripe the number is added to the Stripe subscription, prorated, before Cooper buys it. Otherwise billing.status is stub and this call does not charge. The number can receive SMS. Send returns 409 outbound_not_registered. Inputs: inbox_id (required), area_code or phone_number, idempotency_key (optional). Returns the phone number and billing.

area_code.description: Three-digit US area code to search, for example 415. Use this or phone_number.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key. Retrying with the same key returns the first result and does not buy a second number.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) that owns the phone number. Get it from cooper_list_inboxes.

phone_number.description: A specific available number in E.164, for example +14155550100. Use this or area_code.

name: cooper_provision_phone_number

outputSchema.description: The new phone number and its billing.

account_id.description: Cooper account id (acct_…) that owns this object.

billing.description: Billing result for this number, such as {status}.

capabilities.description: What the number supports, such as sms and voice.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

id.description: Stable id of the returned object. Pass it to the matching get, update, or delete tool.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

outbound.description: Outbound SMS registration state. Sends fail with outbound_not_registered until it is ready.

released_at.description: ISO-8601 time the number was released, or null.

title: Provision phone number
